titulo.alumno:
«Метод исследования и выборка»
Research method and sample

intro: To assess a study, locate the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.

piezas.titulo: To assess a study, locate the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.
texto: To assess a study, locate the question, the sample, the data collection method and the stated limitations.
A large sample alone does not guarantee that it represents the whole population; check who was left out.

frases.estudio: Авторы опросили 840 жителей из шести районов и отдельно описали метод отбора.
frases.alumno: The authors surveyed 840 residents of six districts and described the selection method separately.

frases.estudio: В исследование не вошли жители пригородов, поэтому выводы относятся только к городской выборке.
frases.alumno: The study did not include residents of the outskirts, so its conclusions refer only to the urban sample.

opciones.texto: No residents of the outskirts took part
opciones.explicacion: The second sentence explicitly limits the scope of the sample.

opciones.texto: It was not stated how many people took part
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Авторы опросили 840 жителей из шести районов и отдельно описали метод отбора.»

frase.texto: Авторы опросили 840 жителей из шести районов и отдельно описали метод отбора.

opciones.texto: The authors surveyed 840 residents of six districts and described the selection method separately.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The study did not include residents of the outskirts, so its conclusions refer only to the urban sample.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: В исследование не вошли жители пригородов, поэтому выводы относятся только к городской выборке

piezas.traduccion: The study did not include residents of the outskirts, so its conclusions refer only to the urban sample.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
